# Smyrna Tools

> Smyrna Tools is the internal operations application for Smyrna Ready Mix, a concrete
> ready-mix producer. It covers plants, fleet assets, personnel, productivity, and
> efficiency across regions. An account is required to use it.

The sign-in page at the site root, the privacy policy, the terms of use, and the contact
page are the only publicly reachable pages. Every screen that holds data sits behind
authentication, so no plant, fleet, personnel, or reporting content is publicly readable
or indexable.

Crawling for model training and retrieval-augmented answering is refused in robots.txt for
GPTBot, Google-Extended, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, and CCBot.

## Public pages

- [Sign in](https://www.smyrnatools.com/): Sign-in for Smyrna Ready Mix staff, alongside
  links to the company site and the fleet telematics platform.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.smyrnatools.com/privacy): What the application records about
  the people using it, where it is held, and who can see it.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.smyrnatools.com/terms): The conditions attached to an account,
  covering roles, operational records, exports, and how access ends.
- [Contact Us](https://www.smyrnatools.com/contact): Where to take a question about access,
  a fault in the application, or the company itself.

## Related sites

- [Smyrna Ready Mix](https://smyrnareadymix.com): The company site, covering concrete
  services, plant locations, and how customers request an order.
